assumption_notes: All analysis values are engineering scenarios inherited from the concept or newly labeled assumptions, not measurements or vendor specifications.
The 4 kg design case is not a mass estimate. Measure the heaviest intended configuration before selection.
Rolling resistance, driven-weight fraction and efficiency are placeholders; caster scrub and turning resistance are not calculated.
Battery voltage and average-power cases are arithmetic scenarios only. Chemistry, charger, pack, fuse and current remain unselected.
The official tire STL supports geometry studies, not official tire mass, friction, compliance or initial-pose claims.

drivetrain.name: Two encoder gearmotors plus low-scrub support
drivetrain.benefit: Simple forward/reverse/spin control and two motor channels.
drivetrain.risk: Caster scrub, unequal wheel loading and turn odometry error.
drivetrain.decision_test: E02/E03 against traction, straightness and spin-error gates.

drivetrain.name: Four driven wheels
drivetrain.benefit: More driven contact area and redundancy against a light wheel.
drivetrain.risk: More scrub, current, mass and control channels; does not automatically improve turning.
drivetrain.decision_test: Test only if two-wheel mule cannot meet traction or loading gates.

tire_handling.name: Passive capture fork/cradle and release
tire_handling.benefit: Fewest actuators and simple failure recovery.
tire_handling.risk: Alignment, initial pose and TPU friction sensitivity; current lab shape is not a proven mechanism.
tire_handling.decision_test: E04 identical placement matrix and retention/release trials.

tire_handling.name: Guided expanding-bore capture with lift
tire_handling.benefit: Uses the documented bore and can retain geometrically rather than relying only on clamp friction.
tire_handling.risk: Requires pose/access confirmation, alignment, tine clearance, lift volume and jam recovery.
tire_handling.decision_test: E04 after physical bore and access measurements; no unverified 80 g tire-mass assumption.

tire_handling.name: Active outside-diameter gripper
tire_handling.benefit: Does not require insertion into the bore and may tolerate more poses.
tire_handling.risk: More sweep, clamp load, control and possible interference with box or robot envelope.
tire_handling.decision_test: E04 with measured tire deformation and full swept-envelope checks.

experiments.title: Inventory and metrology gate
experiments.purpose: Record school/home access, tools, measurement capability and battery policies before proposing spend.
experiments.method: Owner records available scale, calipers, multimeter, bench supply, fabrication and supervised test space; unknown is acceptable.
experiments.sample: One dated inventory and access record.
experiments.pass_gate: Enough measurement and supervision identified for E01–E05; otherwise borrow or revise the experiment before buying parts.
experiments.output: Actual measured inputs and resource constraints.

experiments.title: Tire geometry and material characterization
experiments.purpose: Separate official STL geometry from physical-tire mass, friction, compliance and pose.
experiments.method: Inspect/measure the official tire when accessible. An organizer-STL print may test geometry only and must be labeled a surrogate with its own measured mass/material.
experiments.sample: Three repeated measurements per dimension; five mass readings; actual tire and surrogate recorded separately.
experiments.pass_gate: Versioned dimensions/mass/material and permitted initial-pose set exist before mechanism freeze.
experiments.output: Mechanism input sheet; no friction transfer from a printed surrogate to the official tire.

experiments.title: Motor/gearbox bench characterization
experiments.purpose: Measure candidate output speed, torque/current and thermal behavior instead of trusting nominal RPM.
experiments.method: Use supervised instrumentation and a safe fixture at min/nominal/max intended bus voltage; record loaded speed, continuous current, peak/stall data from the actual motor/driver combination.
experiments.sample: Three runs per operating point after a repeatable warmup; log voltage, current, speed, torque and temperature.
experiments.pass_gate: At measured design mass, loaded output meets calculated RPM/torque margins and driver limits with no thermal or protection fault.
experiments.output: Measured motor curves and evidence for driver, fuse and wire ratings.

experiments.title: Ballasted rolling-chassis traction and control
experiments.purpose: Test two-wheel drive plus support under changing mass and surface conditions.
experiments.method: Instrumented mule with full-footprint ballast at 2, 4 and 6 kg; straight 1 m runs and left/right 180-degree spins on documented field-like surfaces.
experiments.sample: Ten straight runs and twenty spins per direction per mass/surface cell; include hot repeated runs.
experiments.pass_gate: At 4 kg, at least 9/10 straight runs drift no more than 25 mm over 1 m; all commanded runs reach 8 in/s cruise without slip/thermal faults; median spin error no more than 5 degrees and every trial is logged.
experiments.output: Measured traction, tracking, spin error and current; decide 2WD-CASTER versus fallback.

experiments.title: Tire-mechanism bake-off
experiments.purpose: Compare all three capture concepts under identical placement, alignment and retention conditions.
experiments.method: Vary lateral offset -12.7/0/+12.7 mm, yaw -10/0/+10 degrees, and documented pose class. Add tilt/upright only as diagnostic cases until official poses are known. Use the same approach and fixture for each concept.
experiments.sample: Per candidate and officially required pose class: five attempts at each of nine alignment cells plus five nominal repeats (50 total), then twenty retention and twenty release attempts for qualifying concepts.
experiments.pass_gate: For every officially required pose class: at least 48/50 acquisitions overall and 4/5 in each alignment cell; 20/20 retention through acceleration and both spin directions; 20/20 releases; no tire damage or uncontrolled jam. Unknown-pose failures remain visible.
experiments.output: Architecture decision based on success, recovery, mass, volume and measured actuator loads.

experiments.title: Integrated docking, recovery and power-off review
experiments.purpose: Prove that a failed exchange can end cleanly and that power/safety integration is testable.
experiments.method: Run instrumented low-speed docking, inject acquisition failures, and conduct supervised power-isolation, fuse/wiring and emergency-stop reviews on a secured fixture.
experiments.sample: Thirty dock cycles and ten injected failures; repeat after hot operation.
experiments.pass_gate: At least 28/30 docks complete; 10/10 failed acquisitions retreat within the 20 s engineering bail-out; emergency power removal passes every supervised trial with no unintended drive output.
experiments.output: Reliability record and updated component requirements, not a scoring adjudication.
